chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Saʿd ibn Abī Khalaf, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام and said: I instructed my slave to perform tamattuʿ. He said: If you wish, then slaughter on his behalf; and if you wish, then instruct him to fast.

key_terms.فَٱذْبَحْ: then slaughter; offer the sacrificial animal
key_terms.مَمْلُوكِي: my slave; the owned servant under the speaker’s authority

ai.seo_question: If a slave performs tamattuʿ with his master's permission, must the master provide the sacrificial offering?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a slave who performs tamattuʿ with the permission of his master. Imam Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام states that the master may either offer the sacrifice on the slave’s behalf or instruct him to fast instead, indicating permissibility in fulfilling the required obligation through either option in this case.
